subject.title: fix: harden recovered meeting browser sessions

question: Should recovered talk-back sessions require an explicit `micMuted: false`, even when a supported adapter may temporarily or persistently omit microphone telemetry?
rationale: The originating extraction identified the old unknown-state behavior as a shipped contract and deferred this exact policy choice; source tests establish fail-closed behavior but the supplied proof does not establish every supported adapter's live telemetry contract.

options.title: Verify contract, then land
options.body: Confirm Google Meet and Teams always resolve in-call microphone state, then approve the fail-closed rule and the appropriate live-proof evidence or override.

options.title: Accept blocked unknown states
options.body: Intentionally accept that recovered sessions with unavailable microphone telemetry cannot become speech-ready until telemetry becomes explicit.

options.title: Split the policy change
options.body: Land transcript and tab-recovery fixes separately while retaining the prior unknown-microphone behavior until live adapter evidence supports changing it.

recommendation.title: Verify contract, then land
recommendation.body: Confirm Google Meet and Teams always resolve in-call microphone state, then approve the fail-closed rule and the appropriate live-proof evidence or override.
